text:
oliver: Quick sync we're targeting a rollforward to runtime 2.23 tonight 23:15 UTC. Includes kv-cache pointer fix + kernel reorder. Proposing a "compat-brake": throttle unpins for embed/vec-* and longform-qa for a short window.

nayla: What's the SDK story? If SDK 3.7.0 is required for the new header we should add a short fallback snippet and call it out in release notes.

frank: Canary (us-east) shows p95 +5% for vec-embed-quant when kv enabled on first tokens; no error increase. Warmup longer at batch_size=1.

chris: I support a narrow brake. Suggest: pin vec-embed/* -> 2.22 for 5h and pin longform-qa/* -> 2.22 for 3h. Let other model groups proceed to 2.23.

ops-oncall: Recommend deadman revert at 02:30 UTC. Auto-revert if 5xx > 1.2% OR p95 increase > 22% sustained for 10m. Will page release leads on trigger.

deploybot: Automated: snapshotting pinlist at 22:45 UTC. Preview diff:
```
- runtime_unpin: vec-embed/* -> runtime:2.23
- runtime_unpin: longform-qa/* -> runtime:2.23
+ soft_pin: vec-embed/* -> runtime:2.22 until 04:30 UTC
+ soft_pin: longform-qa/* -> runtime:2.22 until 02:15 UTC
+ note: compat_brake_active = true
```

oliver: Decision: enable compat-brake with the two soft_pins. Action items:
- frank: drop a minimal repro + flame graph link by 22:10.
- nayla: update release notes to mention SDK 3.7.0 and include fallback snippet by 22:20.
- deploybot: apply soft_pins at 22:45 and publish pin diff to /releases/2.23/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 02:30 and run smoke traffic for vec-embed pipelines post-roll.

frank: Repro snippet: `summarize(long_doc, chunk=2048)` - first-chunk latency spike observed. Flame graph: https://ci.local/pr/987/flame

nayla: Fallback snippet for notes:
```
client:
  runtime_preference: ["2.23","2.22"]  # SDK 3.7.0 will prefer 2.23 then fallback to 2.22
```

chris: I'll coordinate with CS for customers that asked for pinned stability. DMing CS now with a short comms draft.

ops-oncall: Implemented revert thresholds and paging. If auto-revert fires, deploybot will post the revert and page leads in #oncall.

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pins applied at 22:45 UTC. Pin diff published. Rollforward scheduled 23:15 UTC.

oliver: Reminder: keep eye on safety and correctness signals during canary. If anything looks off, post examples here and tag me. We'll hold further unpins until 08:00 UTC.

frank: Follow-up: traced a tiny hotspot in kv_refresh() for micro-batches; filing follow-up ticket (INF-4921). Not blocking.

nayla: I'll add a short "how to rollback client-side" snippet to the release notes as well.

deploybot: Automated: rollforward started 23:15 UTC. Will post completion or failure updates to #release-ops.

ops-oncall: Post-rollcheck scheduled 23:55 UTC in #release-ops. I'll run targeted smoke for vec-embed and longform-qa and report back.

oliver: Thanks all. Compat-brake enabled. :thumbsup
